manifest.scope:
Saved numerical density Psi and endpoint prior/trace diagnostics.

No RHS, weight solve, update, analytical density or heat adjustment. Initial
theta is restored; each remaining saved state is fitted exactly once. q24/48
uses identical density objects, normalization and prior polygon parts.

endpoint_report.limits: Diagnostic reconstructed Psi, not an evolved conservation law. q24/48 is empirical integration uncertainty, not a rigorous error bound. No long-time validation. Face distributions are Gauss8 length-weighted diagnostics, not original mass flux nodes.

flux_ledger_report.scope:
Saved actual midpoint potential/energy flux ledger; no fit or RHS.

Psi here is a transport rate, not an evolved state or reconstructed integral.
Endpoint reconstruction and its q24/48 uncertainty are a separate diagnostic.

stage0.frozen_note: Frozen evolution is masked to zero; unmasked face/gravity exchange is separately retained, not claimed to evolve.

midpoint.frozen_note: Frozen evolution is masked to zero; unmasked face/gravity exchange is separately retained, not claimed to evolve.

flux_ledger_report.limits: Stored moment model flux ledger only. Potential transport is not an evolved variable. Numerical reconstructed endpoint Psi/q24-q48 still required; no analytic density replacement, heat correction or long-time success claim.

face_statistics_note: Face RMS uses Gauss8 length weights. Minimum/median/p90/p99/maximum are sampled-point statistics, with unweighted quantiles; these are not length-weighted quantiles. Interior faces only; analytical exterior mirror states are not synthesized.
regional_note: Regions fixed by initial diagnostic masks; intersected with active. Frozen diagnostic has masked transport zero and is not an evolved Psi law.
